name: Release 3.26.18
body:

* fix(read-aloud): 段落间隔不再重建本章合成任务；reader: 胶囊与标点串不再顶出空洞 by @2408893730 in https://github.com/HapeLee/legado-with-MD3/pull/2443

* fix(readaloud): 修复HTTP朗读在当前章未完成时抢占预合成导致的断流卡顿 by @ISuuuu in https://github.com/HapeLee/legado-with-MD3/pull/2448
